My decision is whether to launch a tightly controlled, limited-access version or to publish an aggressively open release now, while the other lab independently chooses between keeping their system locked down or going aggressively open too.

If I sign while they keep a light regime, my firms will pay more and adopt AI more slowly than theirs, investment will re-route to them, and I will struggle to finance the promised safety nets; this is my worst outcome but relatively attractive for them.
